name: himalayas
description: Himalayas is a remote jobs marketplace. Job seekers search remote jobs by role, country, seniority and salary, save them to an application tracker, tailor a resume and cover letter, get the employer's apply link, track each application to hired and reply to recruiters. Employers post remote jobs for free, search candidates by skill and country and message them. Job search, salary data and company profiles need no account; everything else uses a Himalayas sign-in.

interface.shortDescription: Find remote jobs and hire remote talent from ChatGPT and Codex
interface.longDescription: Himalayas is a remote jobs marketplace. These skills connect to the hosted Himalayas MCP to search remote jobs and companies, check salary benchmarks, tailor a resume and cover letter to a job, track applications and practise interviews, and, for employers, post jobs, keep a company profile current and message candidates, confirming changes first.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find remote jobs that match my Himalayas profile
